$comment: Breaking API changes the team decided to make, recorded before they landed.
scripts/openapi-compatibility.ts reads this. An entry names ONE operation and
ONE path, so it cannot wave through a class of changes. Acknowledged changes
are printed on every run, and a STALE entry -- one that no longer matches a
change against the base -- fails the gate, because an acknowledgement that
outlives its change is a standing pre-approval for whatever lands there next.
Adding an entry is not a way around the gate. It is a way to say, in the diff,
that this specific break is intended and where customers were told about it.
Remove the entry in the same change that merges to the base it was measured
A server extension keeps the entries about its own operations in
reads them all as one list (scripts/contract.ts).
